original_sentence: The authors of the study concede that some might interpret the study's findings to mean that they can delay starting an exercise program but this would be a mistake.
translation: 研究作者承认，有些人可能会把研究发现理解为他们可以推迟开始锻炼计划，但这种理解是错误的。

authors of the study 在本句中对应"该研究的作者"。

delay starting 在本句中对应"推迟开始"。
